_source: cocos2d -hd sheets from assets/textures/gd_atlas/source, repacked by tools/build_godot_atlas.py
_format: frame: [page, x, y, width, height, offset_x, offset_y, source_width, source_height, sheet]; pixels are -hd atlas pixels (2 per Geometry Dash unit); offset is the trim offset, y up, as cocos2d stores it; rotated source frames are stored upright
